_comment: kicad-cli ERC integration config. Wraps the official KiCad ERC engine and normalizes its output into the same issue shape that L1 (basic_checks) and L2 (validator) use, so the fix loop and diagnose see one merged list.

binary._comment: Where kicad-cli lives. If kicad_cli_path is set, it wins. Otherwise we try $env:KICAD_CLI then walk autodetect_paths in order. First existing file wins. Add new install locations here when KiCad ships a new version or the user installs it elsewhere.

invoke._comment: Flags passed to `kicad-cli sch erc`. severity_all = include errors + warnings + exclusions (kicad-cli defaults to errors only, which silently hides 90% of real issues — flip to false only if you want errors-only).

ignore._comment: ERC violation `type` keys to drop before merging into the issue list. Add a type here when you have a project-wide reason to ignore it (e.g. 'footprint_link_issues' on a project that hasn't pulled in footprint libs yet). The list of types comes from KiCad source / .kicad_pro erc.rule_severities.
ignore._severity_filter: Map kicad-cli severities (error/warning/exclusion) to our severities (critical/high/medium/low). exclusion = something the user explicitly waived in the project file; we report it as low so it stays visible without blocking.
